currentFocus: Opening soft-alpha reservations: a public Player name per account, verified email, and up to three reserved character names ahead of Soft Alpha.

currentChange.summary: New accounts choose a public Player name and verify their email before reserving character names; sign-up is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile and rate limits.

latestCompleted.summary: The footer's Character destination opens the current character's profile — portrait, Credits, every skill's progress — and one canonical Character Level replaces the old per-surface levels.

nextStep: Human review of registration, email verification, and Player names, then the one-time cutover that gives existing accounts their Player names.

highlights.summary: Deep Jag is playable: brace the cave-in for Tansy, mine Galvanite behind it, and refine Galvanic Stock and Galvaferrite at the Processing Yard.
Added Rusk Recovery and 10,000 Hours: Wade's own yard, a workbench that practises Welding indefinitely for scrap, and the Clean Pass moment every weld now rolls.
Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
